description: The user's fz-mue.16 iodata answer ("Recursive, proper") accepted that improper iolists are outside iolist until list types carry an improper tail. This ticket adds a tail slot to list types (maybe_improper_list/2, nonempty_maybe_improper_list), and widens iolist to Elixir's definition so an improper iolist is iodata. Related: fz-sc8.22 (improper list [1 | 2] panics at runtime). maybe_improper_list moves here from fz-mue.16's name list.
title: A list type may have an improper tail (maybe_improper_list), so an improper iolist is iodata
